storyHeading: Optometric Cafe – Family-Owned Optical Boutique in Beverly Hills
story: Optometric Cafe, owned and operated by Morteza Talebi, has been serving the Beverly Hills community since 2005. As a family-owned optical boutique in the heart of Beverly Hills, we provide personal eyewear fittings and a curated selection of prescription eyeglasses and designer sunglasses for men, women, and children. Every customer receives individual attention from Morteza himself, ensuring your eyewear is tailored to your prescription, comfort, and style.
workshop: All optical work — from frame selection and precise measurements to lens crafting and final adjustments — is personally handled in-house by Morteza in our advanced optical workshop. For eye exams and vision evaluations, please call to confirm optometrist availability before planning your visit.
complex: Specializing in complex and high-prescription glasses, we use premium lens products and precise optical measurements. This supports exceptional accuracy and meticulous craftsmanship for single-vision, progressive, and specialty lenses.
designers: Our boutique showcases designer frames from Persol, Salt, Oliver Peoples, Prada, Paul Smith, Tom Ford, Lunor, SwissFlex, Anglo American, Maui Jim, Ray-Ban, Alain Mikli, Mykita, and more. Whether you prefer a timeless look or the latest fashion trend, we’ll help you choose frames that reflect your personality and meet your optical needs.
invitation: At Optometric Cafe, your eyewear is in experienced hands. Contact us about a fitting or visit our boutique to experience the difference a family-owned Beverly Hills optical shop can make.
